headline: Fire Damages Damri Bus Depot In Bandung Affecting Multiple Vehicles
seoTitle: Damri Bus Depot Fire In Bandung
metaDescription: A fire at a Damri bus facility in Bandung, West Java, destroyed ten inactive buses and impacted thirteen nearby residential properties on November 8.
aiSummaryBullets: A fire broke out at a Damri bus depot located on Jalan Kebon Kawung in Bandung, West Java, on November 8.
The incident resulted in the destruction of ten inactive buses and caused damage to thirteen surrounding residential homes.
One local resident required medical attention for respiratory issues, while authorities continue to investigate the cause of the blaze.
aiContextParagraph: On November 8, 2026, a significant fire occurred at a bus depot operated by Damri on Jalan Kebon Kawung in the Cicendo district of Bandung. The blaze destroyed ten buses that were reportedly no longer in operation. Beyond the depot itself, the incident impacted thirteen nearby houses. Emergency services were deployed to conduct cooling operations and manage the scene, with one individual reported to be suffering from respiratory distress following the event. Initial reports from local media outlets vary slightly regarding the scale of the damage, with some sources citing ten buses affected and others initially reporting eight. Investigators are currently looking into the circumstances surrounding the incident, including a preliminary mention of a potential electrical short circuit as a possible cause for the fire in the facility.
whyItIsViral: The event reached a high coverage velocity across multiple major national news outlets in Indonesia, driving significant immediate interest.
